admission.justification: Duplicated target censuses or blanket exclusion of copies can either create false work or hide a divergent implementation. One literal declaration plus exact candidate equality retains the real divergence obligation without pretending generated bytes are a second canonical authority.

applicability: Canonical skills and candidate-aware generated-copy projection recognition for the exact generated-copies.json declaration.
conditions: The declaration names canonical skills, the package target and eight harness targets, and its explicit ignore-name/suffix policy; consumers share that parsed authority instead of maintaining divergent target tuples.
Only an exact declared candidate payload equal to the canonical candidate blob and with nonsymlink source/copy is classified as an equal generated copy.
Equal declared copies need no unexplained-row answer; divergent copies, undeclared paths and ordinary excluded files retain their actual obligations.
Candidate settings/card-reference migration must preserve knowledge and reach real quality readiness; implementing the generator/predicate alone is not completed Curator migration.
exclusions: This does not read, synchronize, move or edit the protected hidden mirrors and does not declare their migration complete.
A task pathRules exclusion is not a generated-copy exemption; schema projection is not runtime delivery, test execution, coherence or acceptance.
statement: Canonical skill knowledge belongs under skills and equal declared generated copies have no unexplained-row obligation, while divergent copies and ordinary excluded files retain theirs.
